mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 77 degrees and clear at the Verona Public Library. It is a new moon tonight, and with no rain expected, it will be a dry night with a low of 61 degrees.

In city news, the Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-term strategy, developed with significant community input, focuses on strengthening neighborhoods, supporting local businesses, and enhancing our downtown area while maintaining our natural assets.

There is plenty to do in Verona. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, residents can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, the Wisconsin Brewing Company, Paddy Mac's, The Mill, or The Bogey Factory.

In a noteworthy call for service, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on September 28 at the intersection of CTH-PB and CTH-M, where a 71-year-old driver was cited for failing to keep his vehicle under control.
You have until 10 PM to stop by Culver's and enjoy today's flavor of the day, which is Georgia Peach.
